observations: Photo 0: a cast aluminium engine part with a helical drive gear, long through-studs fitted, Torx-head bolts, lying on an oily workshop floor; another engine part in the background.
Photo 1: the same housing held in a hand, two machined shaft ends with nuts visible on its face, consistent with a twin balance shaft unit.
Photo 2: the housing from another side with a rounded lower section and mounting bolts; a cast mark '5-B' is the only text on the part.
No brand logo, part number or engine code is readable in any photo.
All three photos carry a 'Posted on Jiji Uchenna' watermark, so they are the seller's own advert photos.
The part looks clean and free of visible cracks or broken teeth, but it is not shown running or fitted.

identity.kind: engine oil pump and balance shaft assembly

claims.claim: For Toyota cars like Camry 2018 to present and RAV4
claims.evidence: No Toyota mark or part number readable; cast '5-B' in photo 2 does not establish fitment.
Nothing in the photos shows origin.
No clip of the assembly turning or of an engine running with it.
A loose part carries no mileage record.
No close shots of fasteners or seams; the part is clean, which could also mean it was cleaned after removal.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment: the assembly may not be for the Toyota engines claimed.
risks.proof: Close, sharp photo of the cast or stamped part number on the housing, or a photo of it beside the matching engine code.
risks.if_unproven: as an unmatched used oil pump assembly of unknown fitment

risks.risk: Worn or damaged gears, bearings or pump rotors inside the housing.
risks.proof: Clip of both balance shafts and the pump drive turning by hand, plus close shots of every gear face.

risks.risk: Missing internal parts or cracked housing out of view.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides and the pump face with the cover off.

proof_requests: Close, in-focus photo of any part number on the housing
Clip of the shafts and pump drive turning by hand
Photos of all sides and gear faces, including the side not shown
Photo of the engine it came from showing the engine code
response.reason: The item is clearly an engine oil pump with balance shaft assembly, so it can be priced by type at its worst case: fitment unconfirmed and treated as not working. A readable part number and a turning clip would raise it.
